mergedPRs.title: fix(posts): increase customizeDisplayPrices.price validation limit to 200 characters (KAT-11237)
mergedPRs.author: ruicaiext-1m
mergedPRs.body:
## Summary
- Fixed DTO validation rule for `customizeDisplayPrices.price` from 50 to 200 characters
- Resolves BadRequestException when saving Event Post styles with long venue/timezone strings

## Root Cause
Event Post `price` field is a display string assembled from Event info:
```json
{ "price": "CCC Trail, Clearfield | Sun, Sep 28, 2025 12:00 AM (PDT)" }
```
Format: `"${Event.venue} | ${formatDate(Event.startDate, Event.timezone)}"`

Example strings exceed 50 characters → validation failure.
